title: [finding] the duplicate-name refusal on `sys_permission_set` carries NO machine-readable `code` — a bare 409, and it fires BEFORE the packaged-set guard, so the Clone dialog's most likely error never reaches `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`

Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 3 (`session_01HnRAeVTLJevtQ5iCPX6JSm`) out of the #19195 reading round. ⛔ Not triaged, ⛔ no `domain:*`, ⛔ no priority — routing and first-touch grading are the triage seat's. The fix lands in `packages/plugins/plugin-security` ⇒ `domain:services` by the domain table.

⏱️ Measured 2026-09-20T10:27–10:36Z against `origin/main` `f93beea0a69ba0780347d16e883cc47ef4ab57b1`, `examples/app-showcase`, seeded admin over a cookie session.

## The defect

```
POST /api/v1/data/sys_permission_set {"name":"showcase_manager"}
→ 409 {"error":"[Security] permission set 'showcase_manager' already exists","object":"sys_permission_set"}
```

⇒ **no `code` key at all.** The caller gets prose.

**Producer**: `permission-set-projection.ts:1184` throws a bare `Error` with `.status = 409` and **no `.code`**.

## ⭐ The ordering is what makes it bite

That throw runs **BEFORE** `assertPermissionSetNotPackageDeclared`. ⇒ an admin who opens the Clone dialog on a packaged set and types **the base set's own name** — the single most likely thing to type — gets this bare 409 and **never reaches `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`**. The refusal that explains the actual situation is unreachable on the most common path.

## The declared contract it violates

ADR-0112 amendment 2026-08-17 (#9232), quoted: 「the flat door narrows too, so "every door" is literal」 — `packages/rest`'s flat `{ error, code }` responder must carry the closed member its status derives from. A 409 with no `code` is that contract unhonoured.

⇒ class (b): violates an already-declared contract, with the contract text cited.

## Why it matters beyond tidiness

objectui#5987's item 3 requires 「the server's refusal is surfaced as the same guidance, not a generic error toast」. For the *packaged-set* refusal that is satisfied — `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` is a top-level `code` on both doors (measured on #19195). For **this** refusal it is not, so the one dialog that needs both gets one machine-readable and one prose-only, and a UI is pushed back to string-matching for the second.

## Control

Unauthenticated `PATCH` on the same resource → **401** with `code: UNAUTHENTICATED`; the packaged-set refusal → **403** with `code: NOT_OVERRIDABLE`. ⇒ the flat responder **does** carry `code` on other paths, so its absence here is specific to this producer, ⛔ not a property of the door.

## Dedupe words

`permission set already exists 409 no code` · `duplicate name refusal missing error code` · `ADR-0112 flat door code member` · `permission-set-projection 409 bare Error` · `clone dialog duplicate name code`
